name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '08' is the dispatch-table index (idx 0x08 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91; entry confirmed at 0x51BB1 = base 0x51B91 + 8*4, bytes cd 4d 03 00 -> 0x34DCD), a meaningful slot ID matching the uniform handler_NN naming across all siblings in chevt1.c, not an address residue. 'ch13' is chapter 13 (valid 1-30 chapter ID). 'first_time' accurately describes the consumed-flag gate that limits the beat to running once. No hex address residue in the name.
purpose: Chapter 13 first-time-gated tile-step item pickup: when the lord (char 0) steps on the trigger tile with a non-full inventory and the trigger unfired, give the lord item 0x59 (勇者徽章, the item that class-changes 索爾/Sol to Hero), show dialog page 0xB, and consume the trigger so it runs at most once.
logic_summary: Dispatched as idx 0x08 of the handler table at 0x51B91; the arg is the id of the char who stepped on the tile (tile-step calling convention). Three gates: (1) stepping_char_id == 0 (only the lord triggers it); (2) fd2_count_usable_inventory_slots(0) != 8 (the lord's used-slot count; 8 == full inventory); (3) tile-event consumed-flag byte [0x10] == 0 (not yet fired). When all three pass: fd2_add_item_to_inventory(0, 0x59), fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page 0xB, fixed dialog geometry), then write 1 to consumed-flag byte [0x10] to consume the trigger. No RNG, no numeric computation; the only CALL-return value used is the slot count. Inside the char-0 gate stepping_char_id is provably 0, so it is the value passed to both inventory calls (matches the original PUSH of the stack arg).

params.name: stepping_char_id
params.semantics: Id of the character who stepped onto the trigger tile (tile-step dispatch arg). Gated to == 0, so only the lord (char 0) fires the beat; within the gate it is provably 0 and is passed to fd2_count_usable_inventory_slots and fd2_add_item_to_inventory.
params.reason: Name accurately reflects the tile-step arg semantics (the stepping char id) and carries no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. fd2_display_dialog_scene's uint32 return is discarded.
